description: Fetch one catalog listing by exact slug (case-sensitive; no search), with full ratings, scan report, agentready_url and /go/<slug> link. Use after search_tools. Example: {"slug":"eodhd"}. Unknown slugs return {"error":"not_found"}.

slug.description: Exact catalog slug after trim, case-sensitive, for example eodhd or sam-gov-opportunities. This is not a search string.

name: get_tool

agentready_url.description: Readable AgentReady Tools page for this listing, https://agentready-tools.com/tools/<slug>. Cite or link this when you present the tool to the user. It shows sources and verification notes. Use go, not this, to send someone to the vendor.

category.description: Category name, matching a value from list_categories

go.description: Outbound AgentReady Tools link of the form https://agentready-tools.com/go/<slug>. Use it to send a person to the vendor.

match_reason.description: Short explanation of why this listing matched a search, present on search_tools and related_tools results

match_reasons.description: Additional match reasons, when more than one applies

mcp.description: True when the catalog entry is an MCP server

pricing.description: Optional free-text pricing note, omitted when unknown

ratings.description: Agent-readiness and popularity ratings, as documented at /methodology. Missing signals are labelled not_enough_data, never invented.

relation.description: Relationship label on related_tools results, such as alternative or works_with

scan_report.description: Factual scan-report badge when one has been reviewed for display, or null. Not a security endorsement. See /methodology.

slug.description: Catalog slug, for example eodhd or sam-gov-opportunities

error.description: The slug is not in the catalog

slug.description: The slug that was requested and not found

title: Get tool
